subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: Should OpenClaw require a fresh maintainer-run macOS Chrome MCP live trace before attempting another fix for these `profile=user` all-page-tool timeouts?
rationale: Source inspection proves the relevant OpenClaw paths still delegate to Chrome DevTools MCP, but the merged partial fixes and upstream `chrome-devtools-mcp@latest` dependency mean the remaining failure cannot be safely assigned to a narrow OpenClaw patch without live proof.

options.title: Capture live macOS trace first
options.body: Run current main or latest release against Chrome 148+ with `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate` plus Chrome MCP/debug logs before choosing the repair boundary.

options.title: Document unsupported Chrome mode
options.body: If the trace shows Chrome permission-gated debugging cannot support these MCP page tools reliably, update diagnostics and docs instead of adding wrapper retries.

options.title: Sponsor wrapper/upstream repair
options.body: If the trace isolates an OpenClaw timeout, target-id, or session-reset bug, land a focused browser-plugin fix with regression coverage and upstream contract notes.

recommendation.title: Capture live macOS trace first
recommendation.body: Run current main or latest release against Chrome 148+ with `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate` plus Chrome MCP/debug logs before choosing the repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced or merged the central existing-session and partial-fix history and is the current live assignee.
